assumptions: This is a modeled monthly cost profile, not a live billing export.
Core resources are expected to remain online continuously.
Spoke and test resources should be treated as disposable and reviewed frequently.
Network-appliance and IP-line items are generic placeholders for provider-specific equivalents.

resources.name: cloud-hub-node
resources.notes: Small always-on utility VM for WireGuard and remote admin access.

resources.name: hub-storage
resources.notes: Attached storage for configuration, logs, and small operational artifacts.

resources.name: public-ip-or-ingress
resources.notes: Generic placeholder for public IP, reserved address, or ingress service cost.

resources.name: virtual-network-appliance
resources.notes: Generic cost placeholder for a managed or self-hosted network/security appliance role.

resources.name: test-spoke-node
resources.notes: Disposable test node for validation, narrow experiments, or spoke connectivity checks.

resources.name: backup-egress-reserve
resources.notes: Simple allowance for backup export, retrieval, or transfer overhead.
